speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My lord. The old duke. Forty lines. Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He comes in on the cue. My lord. Then the grief. Then the name of the town.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Lost the town. Again. Not from the start. From the place I lost it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. That was to the hedge. The hedge did not answer. Good.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A king come home might stoop. Bare hand on the earth. What do the lords do with their faces.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not that. Thursday first. The duke. Enough.
